p.PACKAGE-INSTALLS-THE-CONVENTIONAL-COMMIT: A vibevm `flow` package that installs the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) message format: a typed header (`type(scope): subject`) and a body that explains *why* a change was made, not *what* the diff already shows.

p.ATOMICITY-IS-THE-SEPARATE-ATOMIC-COMMITS: The complementary discipline — **atomicity**, one commit = one logical idea — is the separate `flow:git-atomic-commits` package.

p.EACH-DISCIPLINE-IS-ADOPTABLE-ON-ITS-OWN: You can follow this format and still write a non-atomic commit (`feat: add foo, bar, and baz`), and you can be atomic without this format; the two run together, and each is its own package so a project can adopt either.

facts.CONTENT-THE-FULL-FORMAT: `spec/flows/conventional-commits/conventional-commits.md` — the full format: header shape, the allowed-type table, scope convention, body structure, worked examples, and anti-patterns.
facts.CONTENT-THE-BOOT-SNIPPET: `spec/boot/31-flow-conventional-commits.md` — the boot snippet loaded at session start.

facts.COMPOSES-ATOMIC-COMMITS: Pairs with `flow:git-atomic-commits` (atomicity) — together they are the commit-message half of a `git-practices` posture.
